Dear [Sir](/person/1143),
My new tale of ‘[Heartsease or The Brother's Wife](/book/19)’ is now complete. I am willing to publish it in the same manner as the ‘[Heir of Redclyffe](/book/13)’ and if you are ready to undertake it, will forward it to you, as soon as I have heard from you. At your convenience, I should be glad to know the state of the account of [The Little Duke](/book/20).
Yours faithfully,

C M Yonge
